description.para: Read supplementary canopy variables from text file

Reads supplementary canopy variables from a text file into the canopy variables array. Used for additional canopy-specific inputs.

Path to input text file containing canopy variables

detaileddescription.para: This file contains the main calculation subroutine that orchestrates all canopy model computations including radiation, wind, biogenic emissions, dry deposition, and other canopy processes.
Includes urban/non-vegetated aerosol dry deposition velocity calculation using Pleim et al. (2022) Output variable: vdep_aero_3d (2D) or vdep_aero (1D)
